ocr.description: Recognizes text in images for search and copying.
ocr.feature: Recognizes the text in images you copy. You can then find an image by its text, use “Copy Text in Image” from the context menu, or switch the preview to Text to pick and copy part of it.
ocr.how: Uses the system's built-in text recognition: Windows.Media.Ocr on Windows and the Vision framework on macOS. Recognition runs in a separate background process that starts only when there are new images and exits when it is done, so it doesn't stay in memory. Supported languages depend on the language packs installed on the system. On Windows you can also download a more accurate PP-OCRv6 engine.
ocr.name: Image text recognition
ocr.privacy: Recognition happens entirely on this device. Neither images nor recognized text are uploaded.
ocr.uninstallContent: New images will no longer be recognized; recognized text is kept.

wetype.coexist: WeType is running on this computer: it handles clipboard exchange, and KwikPaste only records what your phone sends into history.
wetype.description: Exchange copied text and images with WeType (微信输入法) on your phone.
wetype.feature: Text and images you copy here appear in WeType's clipboard on your phone, and what you copy on the phone comes into KwikPaste, usually within seconds. Your phone needs WeType with this computer linked under 跨设备粘贴传送 (cross-device paste).
wetype.how: Built on an analysis of WeType's cross-device clipboard protocol (the open-source wx-ime-sdk) and runs in a separate background process. It is not an interface provided by Tencent: it may stop working after a WeType update, and Tencent may restrict it.
wetype.installContent: This is an unofficial feature based on an analysis of WeType's protocol, not an interface provided by Tencent. It may stop working after a WeType update, Tencent may restrict it, and synced content passes through Tencent's servers. Install it?
wetype.name: WeType sync
wetype.notPairedDescription: In WeType on your phone, open 跨设备粘贴传送 (cross-device paste), link a device, and enter the 6-digit code shown.

wetype.privacy: Synced content passes through Tencent's servers, just like WeType's own cross-device paste. Items marked sensitive and files are never sent.
